postReview.title: Colorado Rapids 2-3 Inter Miami: Messi ensures winning start for interim boss Hoyos
postReview.description: Inter Miami were rocked by Javier Mascherano's exit this week, but Lionel Messi's magic secured victory in front of a huge crowd in Denver.

postReview.title: Colorado Rapids 2-3 Inter Miami: Messi asegura un debut ganador para el técnico interino Hoyos

postReview.title: Colorado Rapids-Inter Miami 2-3: Messi firma l'esordio vincente di Hoyos ad interim

postReview.title: Colorado Rapids 2-3 Inter Miami : Messi offre des débuts victorieux à l’entraîneur intérimaire Hoyos
